title: DFD level 0 — VVS Hospital ERP (context)
sub: Everyone outside the system and what passes between them
caption: DFD level 0 — the whole hospital in context: patients and families, online booking, doctors, nurses, front desk, lab, pharmacy, payers, suppliers, banks and FBR, management.

title: DFD level 1 — VVS Hospital ERP
sub: 1–5 the patient's path · 6–10 pharmacy, money, buying and reports
caption: DFD level 1 — the whole hospital: appointments → OPD → lab → emergency and admission → ward care and discharge, then pharmacy, cash counters, finance, buying and reports.

title: Process flow — the patient journey
sub: From an online booking to the report, the pharmacy and discharge
caption: Process flow — the patient journey: appointment, registration, OPD slip, nurse vitals, doctor, lab paid at reception, sample to report, pharmacy, admission, ward care, discharge and the money.

title: DFD level 1 — OPD
sub: Booking → registration → slip & token → nurse → doctor
caption: DFD level 1 — OPD: appointments (counter, web, WhatsApp), registration with duplicate check, the OPD slip and token, nurse vitals, the doctor's prescription.

title: DFD level 1 — laboratory
sub: Order → paid at reception → sample → result → verification → report
caption: DFD level 1 — laboratory: orders from the doctor or a walk-in, payment at the reception counter, samples, results with ranges and flags, the pathologist's verification and the report.

title: DFD level 1 — wards & emergency
sub: Arrival → triage → admission → ward care → final bill → discharge
caption: DFD level 1 — wards & emergency: ER arrival and triage, admission with an advance, ward care (vitals, MAR, diet, labs, procedures), the discharge summary, the final bill and discharge.

title: DFD level 1 — pharmacy & store
sub: Prescription → POS → pick → review → handover; stock in and out
caption: DFD level 1 — pharmacy and store: the POS (prescription, walk-in, credit), the pick → review → handover pipeline, receiving, transfers, cycle counts and returns.

title: DFD level 1 — cash & finance
sub: Shift → collections → close → approval → ledger → reports
caption: DFD level 1 — cash and finance: shifts per counter, collections by mode, the close (notes counted, card and wallets from the system), supervisor approval, vouchers posted in batches, finance reports.
